subject: Medford City Hall 80th Anniversary Dedications
overview: The city held a ceremony to celebrate the 80th anniversary of Medford City Hall and unveil memorials for distinguished citizens and former officials. The event featured the dedication of several plaques and portraits to honor community service and the building's historical significance.

items.title: Citizens of the Year Plaque
items.summary: Unveiled a permanent plaque honoring Citizens of the Year recipients since 1971 and observed a moment of silence for deceased honorees.

items.title: Building Anniversary and Restoration
items.summary: Mayor Burke highlighted over $2 million in recent restorations to the building's roof, dome, and foyer to preserve its integrity for the 80th anniversary.

items.title: Mayor Irwin Portrait Dedication
items.summary: Dedicated a portrait of former Mayor Irwin, who secured the funding and construction for the current City Hall 80 years ago.

items.title: Stephen C. Honeycutt Plaque
items.summary: Honored the late Stephen C. Honeycutt with a plaque recognizing his 25 years of advocacy on the Commission for Persons with Disabilities.

items.title: Richard Lee Portrait Dedication
items.summary: Unveiled a portrait of former City Manager Richard Lee, celebrating his career and service to the residents of Medford.

items.title: Closing and Community Recognition
items.summary: Concluded the celebration by recognizing Medford High School musicians and the Jingle Bell Festival organizers for their contributions to city life.
